rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: At the sitting of 18 June 2014 the Deputy Speaker announced that the Deputy President, Mr M C Ramaphosa, had been designated Leader of Government Business in the National Assembly under section 91(4) of the Constitution.

locator.section: [4] Appointment of Leader of Government Business

rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: Annexure 2 records that on 16 July 2014 the President informed the National Assembly of appointments made under sections 91(2), 91(3) and 93(1) of the Constitution; the list opens with The President of the Republic, Mr J G Zuma, and The Deputy President, Mr M C Ramaphosa.

locator.section: Annexure 2, Appointment of new Ministers and Deputy Ministers
